cover_letter:
Dear Setrex Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Digital Marketing Specialist role at Setrex. Your focus on driving digital marketing strategies for eCommerce brands, coupled with a commitment to performance optimization and measurable results, deeply resonates with my professional aspirations and experience. I am confident that my technical foundation, analytical skills, and hands-on experience in digital marketing make me a compelling candidate.

During my tenure as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have been responsible for owning on-page SEO and crafting keyword-targeted content, significantly improving organic visibility and search rankings for client websites. I meticulously track site performance using a suite of tools including Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads. This experience directly aligns with your need for someone who can continuously analyze campaign performance and provide detailed reports to inform data-driven decisions.

My personal project, mirook.com, further highlights my ability to implement and optimize digital strategies. Here, I applied advanced technical SEO and GEO audits, structured data, and entity optimization, which measurably raised the site's overall search-health score across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This initiative demonstrates my creative mindset, proactive approach to solving challenges with innovative strategies, and passion for leveraging data to fuel growth, all key aspects you seek in a Digital Marketing Specialist.

I am comfortable with content management and social media coordination, and I am actively growing my expertise in e-commerce content management and campaign support. My quick adaptability to new tools and platforms ensures I can stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends, contributing effectively to cross-functional teams and client collaborations. I am eager to apply my skills to develop, implement, and optimize paid media campaigns for your clients.

Thank you for considering my application. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to contribute to Setrex's success and welcome the chance to discuss how my capabilities can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

## Profile
Dynamic junior digital marketer with a robust technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO, focused on driving measurable online visibility and performance. At Episto, I execute on-page SEO and keyword-targeted content strategies, managing full-cycle WordPress site builds and maintenance for clients. My work includes tracking site performance with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads to inform data-driven decisions. Through my personal project, mirook.com, I demonstrably improved search health scores by applying structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits for both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I am adept at content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting, with a strong commitment to leveraging data for growth and a keen interest in expanding into e-commerce content management and campaign support.
